title: Sequenced Risk-Aware Config Apply for Batching & Cache Advisor
creator: Lena Kim
description: Build a sequenced, risk-aware apply mechanism for automated batching and KV-cache configuration recommendations. The goal is to safely reduce per-token cost while protecting latency and throughput SLOs across tenant cohorts. This ticket implements a staged traffic-shift controller, per-cohort risk scoring, SLO-aware routing overrides, limiter guards, and an anomaly detection trigger for automated rollback. The implementation must integrate with the Optimize engine recommender and the Console rollout orchestration APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Automated recommend->apply flow can run against a shadow cohort without affecting production traffic
Sequenced rollout engine supports at least three tiers: shadow, 1% canary, progressive ramp to 50% with automated hold points
Risk score is computed per-cohort using latency headroom, error rate delta, and throughput variance and stored in the experiment record
SLO-aware router will divert traffic to fallback model/variant when projected p95 > configured guardrail
Anomaly detector triggers automatic rollback if latency p95 exceeds SLO by >20% for 3 consecutive 1-minute windows or error-rate increases by >=1.0 percentage point
Metrics and dashboards show token-level cost delta and latency-by-cohort during each phase
End-to-end tests cover canary, ramp, hold, and emergency rollback scenarios in staging
comments: 2026-03-01 - Lena Kim: Ticket created after spike analysis showed regressions when applying cache aggressive profiles cluster-wide. Goal: make config apply process safe and observable.

2026-03-02 - Marco Rivera: Initial design sketch completed. Propose three-phase rollout (shadow -> micro-canary -> progressive ramp). Drafted risk score formula: 0.5*latency_headroom_ratio + 0.3*error_rate_delta_norm + 0.2*throughput_variability_norm.

2026-03-03 - Priya Nair (SRE): Reviewed limiter design. Recommend adding per-tenant reserve headroom: min(5ms, 10% of p95) to avoid starving latency-sensitive tenants. Also suggested a fast-path circuit that immediately diverts to warm fallback on sudden p95 jump.

2026-03-04 - Marco Rivera: Implemented prototype of sequencer and added EWMA+seasonal anomaly detector. EWMA half-life tuned to 30s to catch sudden regressions but avoid noisy flips. Integrated detector with rollout controller so an anomaly can pause ramping.

2026-03-05 - UX Design (Evan Brooks): Console needs a compact experiment timeline UI: phase markers, cohort population, live risk score, and a single-click emergency rollback. Provided wireframes and notes linked in related_links.
2026-03-06 - QA (Sofia Delgado): Added staging test matrix. Found a race when cohort traffic is rebalanced during autoscaling events — test case added. Repro steps and minimal repro attached to PR.
2026-03-07 - Marco Rivera: Canary run scheduled against internal tenants on 2026-03-09. Dashboard panels created. Next: finalize guardrail thresholds and update docs for on-call runbook.
